title: Podesta staffer mentions 'the UFO project'
place_text: Center for American Progress, Washington DC

tellings.quote: And at one point, there's an individual mentioned and one of the staffers said, "Uh John, maybe we should consider this individual for the UFO project."

plain: In emails to John Podesta, a former White House chief of staff, a staffer around 2015 suggested a person for what he called "the UFO project." Jason Simosa, a researcher, tells Michels this from the Podesta emails that the WikiLeaks site published in 2016, quoting the staffer as writing, "John, maybe we should consider this individual for the UFO project." The line shows Podesta's circle used the phrase. What that project was, and how far it went, the line itself does not say.
